verdict.rationale: Trello is a SaaS work-management product with AI features, so a data-training opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack has no documentation of any AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy, or training-exclusion control. Mentions of an AI writing assistant and an MCP server concern AI features, not whether user data is used to train models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
